turns: 买过数码类目商品的用户有多少？
final_gold_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND p.category = '数码'
);
